## Checklist

- [ ] A test failed first for the right reason, then passed.
- [ ] `just ci` passes (and `just oracle-check` if graphs, ops or the oracle script changed).
- [ ] No performance claim without a reproducible measurement.
- [ ] Docs and the README ops table are updated if behavior changed.
- [ ] Commit titles are lowercase imperative with no `type:` prefix; text is plain ASCII.
